description: This file provides utility functions for creating and managing communication endpoints using MessagePorts in a web extension context, including serialization/deserialization and forwarding of messages.

methods.name: _resolvePort
methods.description: Connects to a runtime port with a given ID and invokes a callback with the port.

methods.name: _deserializePort
methods.description: Creates a pair of MessagePorts, connects one to the extension runtime, and returns the other.

methods.name: createEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a communication endpoint over a given port with serialization and deserialization logic.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Recursively deserializes data received over a message channel, handling ports and binary data.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards messages between a MessagePort and an extension runtime port.

methods.name: isMessagePort
methods.description: Checks if a port is a message port based on its name prefix.

methods.name: serializePort
methods.description: Associates a callback with a port ID for later deserialization.

methods.name: deserializePort
methods.description: Retrieves a port by ID and creates a MessageChannel for communication.

methods.name: createBackgroundEndpoint
methods.description: Creates an extension endpoint for background communication using a runtime port.
